subject: multilevel CFA - predict for level 2 factors

messages.author: 3ad2e3c8753ce3ec
messages.subject: multilevel CFA - predict for level 2 factors
parts:
library(lavaan)

model <- '
    level: 1
        fw =~ y1 + y2 + y3
        fw ~ x1 + x2 + x3
    level: 2
        fb =~ y1 + y2 + y3
        fb ~ w1 + w2
'

fit <- sem(model = model, data = Demo.twolevel, cluster = "cluster")

Only level 1 factors… How do I get level 2 factor scores?

predict(fit) |>
  head()
#>              fw
#> [1,]  0.3477950
#> [2,] -1.1081867
#> [3,] -0.7223419
#> [4,] -0.1357647
#> [5,] -0.1405448
#> [6,] -0.6897045
